title: WhatsApp Help Pages Leaked Hidden Instructions for a Meta Chatbot
summary: Around 80 pages on WhatsApp’s website exposed instructions that were designed for its chatbot, including “WHAT NOT TO SAY.” Meta says a bug caused the issue.
reason: Leaked chatbot instruction pages are a security/prompt disclosure story. It is not a model release or capability, not a research artifact, not a business event (financing, M&A, partnership, revenue, product launch), not policy action, and not an OSS tool release. No rule covers it.
